about: A Rust library for prime tests, factorization and other number theory, used by the uutils factor tool.

prs.title: Factorizing zero now stops with a clear message
prs.broken: Asking for the prime factors of zero crashed with a confusing overflow error in debug builds, and in release builds quietly returned a wrong answer.
prs.changed: The library now stops with a clear message saying zero has no factorization, and its documentation says so.
prs.matters: A program can no longer get a wrong result from zero without noticing.
